reviews.title: Excellent MB for Mid Lever Gaming PC
reviews.comment: I have been running this board for about 18 months. Started with an I5 12600kf and moved up to a i7 12700k. Both processors work great in this board. I did update the bios about a year ago. Just follow the manufactures instruction. MSi RGB controller is Mystic Light and runs in the MSi Control center. I'm using quite a lot of RGB of the board and no problems there. Storage is Two m.2 SSD, one 2.5 SSD and one 5 TB HDD and problems. Seven case fans and a dual fan CPU fan setup on a Tower cooler. They are all connected to the Mother Board with no problems. Finally, GPU, started with a GTX 1660 8GB. Updated to a GTX 3060 LHR 12 GB. Now I have a Gigabyte RTX 3080 FTW3 10GB that runs great in this board. Finally, I am running 32 GB DDR5 two sticks at 6400 MHz XMP 3.0. The board looks great and is made very well. The system has run stable from day one and the only crashes have been from overclocking the GPU to high. I would recommend this board for mid level gaming build. It has all the option anyone might want to use in a gaming PC.
reviews.author: Brian Russell Jones

reviews.title: Great home server board
reviews.comment: Plenty of PCIe slots make it ideal for home server. Worked with 14600k and off-brand DDR5 right out of the box. Hard to beat at this price.
reviews.author: James H

reviews.title: Works great, but READ THE INSTRUCTIONS!
reviews.comment: I struggled getting this thing to read a m.2 drive but it MUST be an nvme (M key) drive not just a regular SATA M.2. This is not mentioned anywhere in the setup manual, i had to read it on the MSI website. I used mine as a jelly fin server. A Thermalright Assassin X120 Refined SE CPU cooler fit right on top of the Intel i5 12th gen processor just fine. Memory slot usage should be 2nd, then 4th away from the CPU, in that order, if using 1 or 2 sticks of ram, respectively.
reviews.author: Shnick

reviews.title: What I was hoping for
reviews.comment:
I would have preferred a printed diagram of the connectors, but the online PDF worked well enough. The board is good and stiff so there were no installation snafus.
The 4 m.2 ssd slots were a surprise, I'm going to want to add another 6T worth of drives so I don't think I'll ever run out of space!
It took me a minute to find a power supply with enough power cables to supply the board and the video card but all in all I'm happy with it.
The wifi worked and kubuntu Linux had no issues configuring it.
reviews.author: G

reviews.title: Nice board
reviews.comment: The MoBo came in its original packaging with all accessories, it works like a charm but the first m.2 slot is or faulty/interfering with my GPU. I’m using the second one, otherwise perfect board
